description: TEXTSPLIT rectangle-shaping splitter — six perspectives spanning 1D row split, 2D grid split, ignore_empty collapse, delimiter-array union (longest match wins), ragged-row padding, and match_mode out-of-range error.

cases.skipped: Spill-producing TEXTSPLIT returns ArrayValue; oracle compare_value only handles scalars, INDEX wrappers blocked by resolve_range_arg. Unit test BuiltinsTextSplit.ScalarColDelimSplitsIntoRow covers semantics.
Spill-producing TEXTSPLIT returns 1x1 ArrayValue when no delimiter matches; oracle compare_value only handles scalars. Unit test BuiltinsTextSplit.NoMatchYieldsSingleCellArray covers semantics.

Spill-producing TEXTSPLIT returns 2x2 ArrayValue; oracle compare_value only handles scalars, INDEX wrappers blocked by resolve_range_arg. Unit test BuiltinsTextSplit.BothDelimitersYield2DGrid covers semantics.
Spill-producing TEXTSPLIT with ignore_empty=TRUE returns ArrayValue; oracle compare_value only handles scalars. Unit test BuiltinsTextSplit.IgnoreEmptyDropsEmptyTokens covers semantics.

Spill-producing TEXTSPLIT with delimiter array returns ArrayValue; oracle compare_value only handles scalars. Unit test BuiltinsTextSplit.ArrayOfColDelimitersSplitsOnAny covers semantics including longest-match precedence.
Spill-producing TEXTSPLIT pads ragged rows in ArrayValue; oracle compare_value only handles scalars. Unit test BuiltinsTextSplit.RaggedRowsPaddedWithNaByDefault covers #N/A pad semantics.
